method: Independently decode and inspect the midpoint of each of 8 subtitle scenes in each final encoded MP4, plus full-resolution PC Word and Android reading frames
checks: Final MP4 SHA-256 values exactly match release/promo/verification.json
Version 2.1.1 is visible on all inspected scenes
No blank, corrupt or black UI scene among the 16 representative frames
Headings and Mandarin subtitles remain within the canvas and readable at native resolution
PC Word scene has no extra revision-history button row
Mobile home and services scenes show five complete bottom feature tabs and top import entry
Mobile reading scene hides top and bottom operation bars
Presentation template scenes contain the actual current template illustrations
Mindmap scenes show the project-list interface
AI scene shows verified-phone sign-in requirement and password-login UI
Both QR codes decoded from final encoded outro frames to https://seal.xingmasoft.com/office/
limits: Edited introduction uses still UI frames with narration; it is not a continuous interaction recording
PC footage is the production responsive Web build; Android footage is the production IIFE layout in a browser, as disclosed in the visible frame labels
This visual review does not replace APK/HAP installation or physical-device testing
Audio full-decode and loudness checks are recorded separately by the generator; this independent review inspected visual frames and subtitle text
